method: numerical search of this atlas (code/simplex_cubature.py: orbit elimination with symmetry group A, Levenberg-Marquardt, manifold walk), checked numerically; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz
